notes.title: The Most Comprehensive VR Fitness Application Ever Built!
notes.content:
What do you get when you mix the world’s best VR fitness mechanics, add a splash of Viro VR Fitness magic and bring to the boil? 

[b]You get the most comprehensive VR Fitness training tool ever!
[/b][b]Viro Move is the indisputable king of room-scale VR Fitness Games
[/b]
- there you go, I have said it and although I may be criticized for being a little biased - I honestly have no idea which other VR Fitness title offers a more comprehensive workout than Viro Move. 

[h1]What makes me so sure?[/h1]
Let me bore you with some Viro Move facts…

The VR fitness genre is heating up – actually most room-scale VR games these days can offer a pretty decent cardio workout. The genre is filled with [strike]BeatSaber[/strike] rhythm games – and why not? Swatting things with your arms in VR is clearly a fun game mechanic which works and has been proven to help people lose weight and get fitter.  

But what if you really want to work out in VR? Meaning a comprehensive full-body routine that can tailor itself to your fitness level, your body type? 

What if you need an application that tracks your progress and can suggest workout intensity based on your historical training data.

[h1]Then you need Viro Move![/h1]
A single Viro Move training session can last between two and a half minutes, typically these are individual leaderboard or tournament challenges. 

Viro HIIT training routines are typically 10, 15 or 20-minute interval training sessions depending on the training type you opt to select. 

With career mode, you can train for up to an hour if you build a playlist (two hours if you feel particularly energetic). Some early Viro Move fans have been known to play three hours at a time.  

In terms of calorie burn — during a two-minute workout at medium/hard level it is possible to burn up to 25 calories — to put that into perspective that’s as much as I can burn in two minutes on an aggressive cycle routine at my gym.  

[h1]Viro VR Fitness Boxing Training[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dHGVaDcmoWI
[b]Conditioning Areas:[/b]
[list][*] Strength
[*] Stamina
[*] Balance
[*] Cardio
[/list]
[b]Primary Muscle Groups worked:[/b]
[list][*] Abs
[*] Biceps
[*] Shoulders
[*] Triceps
[/list]
[b]Secondary Muscle Groups worked:[/b]
[list][*] Calves
[*] Glutes & Hip Flexors
[*] Lower Back
[*] Quadriceps[/list]
Our boxing training contains mechanics that simulate close-range jabs, uppercuts, squats while the player hops from one side to the other dodging obstacles. VR Boxing mechanics are a great way to tighten the core and build stamina and of course sweat out the calories. 

Taking a tight upper body stance while pivoting and hopping from side to side on the balls of your feet brings about the best results from any VR Boxing training.

[h1]Viro VR Sword Training[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFbncGXqNT0
[b]Conditioning Areas: [/b]
[list][*] Speed Training
[*] Agility and Flexibility Development
[*] Posture Building
[*] Cardio Training[/list]
[b]Primary Muscle Groups worked: [/b]
[list][*] Biceps
[*] Triceps
[*] Shoulder muscles
[*] Lower back muscles
[*] Extensors and Flexors
[*] Abdominal muscles[/list]
[b]Secondary Muscle Groups worked: [/b]
[list][*] Calves
[*] Glutes
[*] Hip Flexors
[*] Lower Back
[*] Quadriceps[/list]
Without a doubt, my weapon of choice — just like [strike]BeatSaber[/strike] other games the upper body arm movements will become fast and precise with practice. 

What differentiates Viro Move VR Sword training is our mechanics that promote both accuracy and power. Destroying orbs with accuracy is critical — but when motivated to add extra power to your blows we ensure that your core and arms are being blasted — during medium and hard levels. 

Sword training also requires rapid body stretches from side to side which will help players develop their posture and speed. Unlike Viro VR boxing (which incorporates straight leg squatting), during sword training players are commonly moved out of fast squat into an off-balance long angle stretch to the opposite side which is a critical tool for developing agility and flexibility. 

[h1]Viro VR Shooting Training[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d46p1AFrna0
[b]Conditioning Areas: [/b]
[list][*] Hand-Eye Coordination
[*] Accuracy Development
[*] Reaction Training
[*] Cardio Workout[/list]
[b]Primary Muscle Groups worked: [/b]
[list][*] Quads
[*] Hamstrings
[*] Glutes
[*] Calves[/list]
[b]Secondary Muscle Groups worked: [/b]
[list][*] Abdominal
[*] Deltoids
[*] Lats
[*] Obliques
[*] Lower back[/list]
Viro VR shooting training is commonly referred to as the thinking man’s VR fitness game (at least in our office).

Most gamers who play shoot ’em ups will no doubt have a very refined set of hand-eye coordination skills. In Viro’s VR Shooting we build on this by placing extra focus on a wider range of motor development skills while making you creep around the room in a squat position. 

If Viro VR Boxing training is our strength builder and Viro VR Sword training is our speed trainer, our shooting training takes care of the other motor skills, i.e. the skills that most VR Fitness games tend to miss :-p

Our VR Shooting training requires slow precise and calculated movements — a calm head and perfect timing is critical if a player is chasing the global (or local) leaderboards. The core elements being built are unlike those of any other VR Fitness game, that I am aware of. Think James Bond on his worst leg day and you might understand what it’s like to train with Viro Shooting on a medium to hard level. 

[h1]Viro Weapon Master[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v9OKr8e6k44

OK, where to begin — it’s just an insane workout. We took three of VR’s most challenging fitness mechanics,
[list][*] Boxing
[*] Swords
[*] Shooting[/list]
We added our special Viro VR fitness sauce to enhance each then put them into one pot for you to sweat and boil — then we added a manual weapon changing mode.  

Playing Viro weapon master in manual mode is like nothing you have ever played before. In easy levels it’s a really interesting game, playing in medium or hard levels is just an insane workout. I will go as far as saying it’s the most dynamically challenging VR workout that has ever been built. 

Viro Move VR Weapon Master is the ultimate VR fitness training tool. Nothing in the world of VR Fitness comes even close to this game — end of discussion. 

[h1]Don’t believe me?[/h1]
You can download [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076020/Viro_Move/]the free Viro Move VR Fitness Demo for PCVR on Steam[/url]

Chat to the developers on [url=https://discord.gg/NbQdNQ9]Discord[/url]

Report any suggestions on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076020]Steam community page[/url]

Viro VR Fitness by Fit Reality, Poland - [b]We make Virtual Fitness Applications to make the world happier and healthier! [/b]Thanks for your attention. If you like it please spread the word!

notes.title: VR Fitness Gaming Reinvented
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036866/0686ba8051a0d5c21f3eec4ff5d9db4cf1a2abb2.png[/img]
Viro Move has been described as a Beat Saber / Box VR mashup but we like to think we have gone quite a few steps beyond these amazing VR fitness innovators. 

[previewyoutube=v9OKr8e6k44;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Viro Sword Training[/b][/h1]
This is where the Beat Saber similarities begin and end. Our sword fighting routines are designed to help players build speed, increase reaction times and enhance overall flexibility and agility levels. 
We engage rapid gameplay mechanics which motivate players to achieve full body stretches and fast side skipping movements as they pivot and strike their way through each sword level.    

[h1][b]Viro Boxing[/b][/h1]
Our boxing levels are helping players to enhance their balance, stamina, strength, and power. 
Additional focus is placed on powerful lower squatting step movements to aid lower body strength training. Upper body punching arrives fast and furiously while the lower body maintains slow precise movements. 
[h1]
[b]Viro Shooting[/b][/h1]
These levels are for the cool-headed players, slow precise movements and forward-thinking are needed to dominate our shooting leaderboards. 
Hand-eye coordination, reaction times, slow crouching and squatting movements are all brought into play by Viro Shooting.  

[h1][b]Viro Weapon Master[/b][/h1]
Weapon Master is not for the faint-hearted. Arguably the probably the most dynamic VR Fitness game that has ever been created. Power, strength, agility, speed, movement, agility, hand-eye coordination this is the game where all Viro training elements get squeezed into a single game. 
Players can activate the automatic weapon switcher or Viro Grand Masters might wish to manually activate each weapon while fully immersed in the action. 

[h1][b]Free Game Demo[/b][/h1]
Viro Move is due for release on PCVR pater this year followed by Quest and PSVR in the early new year. Players can have a taste of the by downloading the free demo from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076020/Viro_Move/

Already have the game and want to see how you rank against the world's best Viro Movers? Check out the global VR Fitness Leaderboards: https://leaderboards-demo.viromove.com/#/challenge
